head.objective: equal weight per side over the same-clock, same-phase, <=2mm and <=1deg physical teacher label rows; coefficient in [0,1]; no score/case used for training
head.inputs: current measured world root XYZ minus fixed reference; precomputed reference spatial Jacobian. No engine identifier, observed contact, future simulation, IK teacher or online action labels.
head.parameterization: Use reference minus actual displacement; damped 6D arm Jacobian, orientation weight 0.12m, damping 0.01, per-joint clip +/-0.05 rad, smooth gain for stowed reference arm. All source Actor parameters remain frozen.
